title.en: Planning (Subdivision of Land and Building — Authorisation) Notification 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 12 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Planning (Subdivision of Land and Building — Authorisation) Notification 2008 and shall come into operation on 6th October 2008.
3. Subject to paragraph 6 and any other written law, the subdivision of land comprised in any development of land is hereby authorised.
4. Subject to paragraphs 7 and 9 and any other written law, the strata subdivision of land and buildings comprised in any development of land specified in the First Schedule is hereby authorised.

heading.en: Authorisation for subdivision of land together with strata subdivision

text.en: 5. Subject to paragraphs 8 and 9 and any other written law, the subdivision of land comprised in any development of land specified in the First Schedule and the strata subdivision of any subdivided plot or plots of land and building or buildings thereon forming part of the development are hereby authorised.

heading.en: Conditions of authorisation for subdivision of land
Conditions of authorisation for strata subdivision
Conditions of authorisation for subdivision of land together with strata subdivision
Authorisation not to apply in certain cases

text.en: 9. The authorisation under paragraphs 4 and 5 shall not apply to any development of land within any conservation area as shown in the maps in the Second Schedule.
10. The Planning (Subdivision of Building — Authorisation) Notification (N 11) is cancelled.
